Comment.value: The Thirteenth Ent (roadmap: thirteenth-ent) reward. Handed out at most once per character by ENT_GrantDraught (questcddb key ent13_draught). Tag-based activation script q_ent_drink.nss applies a PERMANENT +1 STR / +1 CON to the base scores via NWNX_Creature, gated advance-only on questcddb key ent13_draught_drunk.

value.0:
A horn cup of ent-draught, drawn from the heartwood of Leaflock of Fangorn: rain that stood in an Ent for an age of the world. It smells of wet bark and far-off thunder.

Drinking it works a permanent change: +1 Strength and +1 Constitution, written into you for good. One draught is all any one soul is ever given -- a second cup is only water and leaf-mould.
